{{Quote|I am Heavy Resource Recovery Machine 5. I will not allow you to open the cases.|HRRM-5|<ref name="Spoils Victor">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Spoils to the Victor|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Heavy Resource Recovery Machine 5''' or '''HRRM-5''' was a powerful [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on Hoth to guard their valuables stoled at the ice caves of [[Loramarr]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed by a hero of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who came to reclaim the stored valuables and cripple the White Maw.
